fields.subject: URGENT: BHS CRITICAL FAILURE
fields.body:
Ops,

We have a major issue. The Sortation Allocation Controller (SAC) has lost its mind. At 10:28 AM, the system began routing ALL bags destined for Concourse A (Delta/United) to the "Manual Encode" pier in the basement.

Impact: The Manual Encode pier is overwhelmed. The belts are jammed.

Status: We have engaged the Emergency Stop (E-Stop) on Belts 1, 2, and 3 to prevent bag damage.

Result: No bags are moving to aircraft. We are dead in the water.

We need you to authorize a switch to "Manual Operations" immediately. We need 20+ staff down here to move bags by hand or we will miss every slot.
fields.signatureBlock:
— BHS Duty Manager
Baggage Handling Systems Control Room · x2210
